text:
Maya S: FYI - distro published a critical glibc CVE that affects our base images. We should coordinate a rebuild + deploy strategy for all services using redwood/base:stable.
Alex I: +1. Do we have a plan for KMS access for image signing keys? RBAC changes might be needed for CI runners.
Sam D: I can update the helm chart for the imagepuller job but need an inventory of which pipelines sign images.
Priya R: Also we need to ensure audit logs capture the signing and push events. Retention needs to be 1y for compliance.
Jon C: Runtime mitigations first: consider enabling seccomp profile and drop CAP_NET_RAW on the affected images. We can ship a temporary AppArmor profile too.
Maya S: Good. Proposal: (1) rebuild base images with patched glibc, (2) push to staging tag, (3) run integration + canary in Dedicated, (4) sign with KMS-backed key, (5) promote. Freeze window tonight 02:00-05:00 UTC?
Alex I: For RBAC: CI runners need 'cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToSign' on the signing key, and 'storage.objects.create' on the registry bucket. I can open the IAM change PR but want @Priya R sign-off for audit policy.
Sam D: Example cosign command we'll use in CI:```bash
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --kms \
  projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/image-sign-key \
  gcr.io/redwood/base:patched-171200
```
Priya R: Please add an entry in the central audit log pipeline so we capture the cosign invocation and registry push metadata (user/service account, key version). Retention: set to 400 days, indexed by svc_account and key_id.
sec-bot: Vulnerability alert: CVE-2026-XXXX glibc - severity: CRITICAL - affected images: redwood/base:stable, redwood/python:3.10-prod. See https://security.redwood.internal/cve/CVE-2026-XXXX
Jon C: We'll also add a runtime rule in the agent to block execve of known exploited paths as a stopgap. Need to coordinate with eng-runtime for a quick agent release.
oncall-bot: Deployment freeze scheduled: 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z to 2026-03-20T05:00:00Z. Blocks: service deployments, image pushes to prod tags.
Maya S: Assigning owners: Alex -> IAM/RBAC PR and KMS ACLs; Sam -> CI/CD pipeline cosign step + build tags; Jon -> runtime guardrails + agent release; Priya -> audit log retention + compliance note. I'll run incident triage and open a vuln-triage ticket.
Sam D: I pushed a draft pipeline change to https://git.redwood.internal/redwood/infra/pipelines#pr-432 - needs review.
Alex I: I'll prepare the IAM changes and link to the PR here. Expect to request temporary elevated access for the runners.
Priya R: Reminder: update the compliance runbook with the new signing key fingerprint and audit query examples.
Maya S: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene 30m before freeze in #eng-security. Post any blockers here.
Jon C: One blocker: some legacy on-prem services use an older runtime and can't accept seccomp changes without testing. I'll list them in the ticket.
Maya S: Noted. Ticket: https://tickets.redwood.internal/SEC-2026-78 (triage + mitigation plan).
Sam D: CI smoke job starting now on staging tag 'patched-171200' - will report results in thread. :spinner:
Maya S: Closing loop: if anyone hits a blocker during the freeze ping @Maya S and page the oncall.
